Extract markdown-aware chunks and pass their content and metadata to your retrieval system.

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ChunkerType, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, mimeType: "text/markdown", uri: "https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md" };
  const config: ExtractionConfig = { chunking: { chunkerType: ChunkerType.Markdown, maxCharacters: 500, overlap: 50, trim: true } };
  const result = await extract(input, config);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.chunks);
}

void main();
```
